records.creator: Autopilot
records.purpose: primary panel geometry and visual facts
records.derivativeStatus: The procedural panel redraw is treated as an adaptation; its panel-art contribution is CC BY-SA 4.0. The source raster is not shipped. Geometry and colour tokens are photograph-measured, unverified proportions rather than physical dimensions.

records.creator: Mike Rosenberg
records.purpose: corroboration only; oblique geometry is not measured
records.derivativeStatus: Used to establish the factory POWER jewel and unit-to-unit variation; the source raster is not shipped.

records.creator: bassmosphere
records.purpose: source for the simulated relay operation cue
records.derivativeStatus: Freesound HQ MP3 preview of a 1970s pinball relay. It is the pinned source for the attenuated relay-cue derivative below and is not an authenticated MINIVAC recording.

records.creator: jwiese
records.purpose: source for the simulated rotary motor and drive-wheel loop
records.derivativeStatus: Published engine/mechanic loop. It is the pinned source for the attenuated wrap-crossfaded rotary-drive-loop derivative below and is not an authenticated MINIVAC recording.

records.creator: bassmosphere
records.derivativeStatus: Derived from the pinned bassmosphere source with ffmpeg 8.1.2: mono 22050 Hz signed 16-bit PCM, fixed-precision gain 0.22. This simulated cue is not an authenticated MINIVAC recording.

records.creator: jwiese
records.purpose: shipped simulated rotary motor and drive-wheel loop
records.derivativeStatus: Derived from the pinned jwiese source with ffmpeg 8.1.2: mono 22050 Hz signed 16-bit PCM, fixed-precision gain 0.18. The final 1103-sample nearest-50-ms segment crossfades into the first, and the output begins and wraps at the corresponding boundary. This simulated loop is not an authenticated MINIVAC recording.

records.creator: bassmosphere
records.derivativeStatus: Derived from the pinned bassmosphere source with ffmpeg 8.1.2: the full decoded transient is reversed with areverse, then attenuated with volume=0.14:precision=fixed and emitted as mono 22050 Hz signed 16-bit PCM; -map_metadata -1 removes source metadata and -fflags +bitexact -flags:a +bitexact make muxer and codec output reproducible. This simulated release cue is not an authenticated MINIVAC recording
